note: Projected punt- and kickoff-return components: returns, return yards and return touchdowns, per game and per season. Per-game rates are the primary output — a consumer holding a better games estimate (the season projection pool publishes one) should multiply the rates by that rather than use the season totals here. Volume is anchored on the CURRENT depth chart (PR1/KR1) blended with the player's own recent rate, because only 47% of players with 8+ returns repeat the job the next year. Kickoff volume is taken from the most recent season only: the dynamic-kickoff and touchback rules moved returns per team-game from 1.08 (2023) to 1.69 (2024) to 3.82 (2025), so any multi-year average is wrong by a factor of two. Return averages are mostly league rate — a returner's own punt average carries r=0.17 year over year, kick average r=0.40. Return touchdowns are the league rate per return for everyone.
